rules.text: Compare request.expectedVersion with the current revision before any patch mutation; mismatch performs no write.
On success shallow-merge the patch over current data, ignore a patch key named revision, and increment revision by exactly 1.
Conflict returns exact {ok:false,error:'VERSION_CONFLICT',currentVersion:<current revision>} with data and revision unchanged.
Successful return and snapshot/read contain copied data; request, patch, initial data and returned data are not shared or mutated.
After a successful update, a later request carrying the older expectedVersion is stale and cannot overwrite the newer state.
Trace is append-only/copied. Every call emits check first, then exactly one of apply or conflict; a conflict never emits apply.

callableSurface.ownership: The updater owns inventory data, revision, and trace. Caller owns immutable request/patch inputs.

transitions: later call compares against latest version

eventOrdering: apply occurs only after successful state mutation
conflict occurs with zero state mutation
exactly one decision event follows each check
abortErrorPrecedence: No thrown error/abort surface. Version conflict is resolved before patch application and has precedence over patch content.

identityMutation.inputs: initial data, request and patch are read only
identityMutation.state: stored data is copied and patch cannot directly set revision
identityMutation.outputs: result/snapshot data and trace entries are copied
